title: The 5-Second Fear Loop
caption:
He stood at the edge of the crowd, heart hammering against his ribs, convinced the world was closing in. Then, he whispered one word: 'Excited.' ⚡️

Psychology reveals that anxiety and excitement are the same physical sensation—the only difference is the label your brain gives it. By renaming your fear, you hijack your nervous system and reclaim your power. 

Have you ever tried renaming your fear to conquer it? 👇
